name: agentic-os-mobile
description: Capacitor shell for the phones: wraps the React web build (../web/dist) with the native iOS targets and the Android app.

scripts.ios: node scripts/ensure-web.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android: node scripts/ensure-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: node scripts/ensure-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
